sections.shortTitle: Representation of the People Eighth Amendment Ordinance 1985
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XXVI OF 1985
ORDINANCE XXVI OF
1985
REPRESENTATION OF
THE PEOPLE (EIGHTH AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1985
An Ordinance further to amend the Representation of
the People Act, 1976
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 19th March, 1985].
No. F. 17 (1)/85-Pub.-The following
Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general information :-
1. Short title and commencement.-(1) This Ordinance may be called the Representation of the People
(Eighth Amendment) Ordinance, 1985.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

sections.shortTitle: Representation of the People Eighth Amendment Ordinance 1985
sections.description:
Amendment of section 50, Act LXXXV of 1976

ORDINANCE XXVI OF 1985
ORDINANCE XXVI OF
1985
REPRESENTATION OF
THE PEOPLE (EIGHTH AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1985
An Ordinance further to amend the Representation of
the People Act, 1976
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 19th March, 1985].
No. F. 17 (1)/85-Pub.-The following
Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general information :-
2. Amendment of section 50, Act LXXXV of 1976.--In the
Representa tion of the People Act, 1976 (LXX3CV of 1976), hereinafter referred
to as the said Act, in section 50, after subsection (2), the following new
subsection shall be added, namely :-
"(3) Notwithstanding anything contained
in subsection (1), a contesting candidate at the elections held under
the Houses of Parliament and Provincial Assemblies (Elections) Order, 1977,
shall not be required to submit a return of election expenses.".

sections.shortTitle: Representation of the People Eighth Amendment Ordinance 1985
sections.description:
Amendment of section 99, Act LXXXV of 1976

ORDINANCE XXVI OF 1985
ORDINANCE XXVI OF
1985
REPRESENTATION OF
THE PEOPLE (EIGHTH AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1985
An Ordinance further to amend the Representation of
the People Act, 1976
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 19th March, 1985].
No. F. 17 (1)/85-Pub.-The following
Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general information :-
3. Amendment of section 99, Act LXXXV of 1976.-In the said
Act, in section 99, in subsection (1), after clause (e), the following new clause shall be inserted, namely :-
"(ee) he, being a person elected to
the National Assembly or a Provincial Assembly, is found by the Commission to
have subscribed, after the commencement of the Representation of the People
(Eighth Amend ment) Ordinance, 1985, either as proposer or seconder, in
contravention of the provisions of this Act or the rules made thereunder, to
the nomination of more than one candidate for a seat or seats ; or".
